notes.title: Added Oculus Rift & Touch support
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26073387/7fefc0fb0b3dc6087455d84b00ce311ca3f6d076.png[/img]
Added: 
[list]
[*]Oculus Rift & Oculus Touch support
[/list]
Controls:
[list]
[*]Trigger - start game / check ground (right hand)
[*]Grip - arcade mode / place flag (left hand)
[*]B or Y - select game mode
[*]Thumb stick button - statistics / teleport
[/list]

notes.title: MineSweeper and Zombies...are you kidding me?
MineSweeper and Zombies...are you kidding me?
Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed GUI layers
[*]Despawn the debris when you start a new game
[/list]

[h1]Iprovements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added captions to the buttons in the menu
[*]Added slider for sound effects & for music
[i]To adjust the volume, move the right stick on the slider, press the trigger and move the slider.[/i]
[*]Added some funny stuff, see video
[/list]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Q9CnGDeX4c
